text.content: **Subject:** Reducing Patient Triage Time with Edge AI - Pilot Program

Dear [Name],

Your veterinary science contributions to pet health are vital to our field. We've developed edge AI tools for clinics that:

- Analyze intake notes, symptoms for faster diagnosis
- Document wounds, skin conditions via computer vision
- Track medication adherence, activity restrictions
- Enable remote patient monitoring between visits
- Reduce routine wellness check visits by 50%

We can deploy at no cost for a 90-day pilot with partner clinics, then transition to subscription model.

Would this align with your strategic priorities?

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
**Subject:** Supporting Vet Clinic Partners with AI Tools - No Patient Cost

Hi [Name],

Our edge AI healthcare tools complement veterinary care:

- Help vet clinic partners improve operational efficiency
- Assist with post-surgery compliance monitoring
- Provide patients (via collars/bowls) with ongoing care support
- Generate revenue through subscription, not patient fees

We can customize for each region's regulatory environment.

Open to a brief call to discuss how we can support your vet network?

Best,
[Your Name]
